title: bug: source-export accepts a bare or in-repository git binary
description: scripts/local-runner/source-export.mjs (R09b exportSourceSnapshot, openCommit/openRepository) accepts `git: 'git'` and an absolute git inside repoDir. On Windows, a bare 'git' resolves against the repository cwd (task-d72fe292), so repository code can run during export. admission.mjs (CQ-R12, task-44a9e97b) already refuses both before any spawn (see admitCandidate and row A1); export should apply the same guard. Evidence: export with git:'git' and cwd=repoDir runs.
definitionOfDone: exportSourceSnapshot refuses a non-absolute git, and an absolute git whose realpath is inside repoDir, with a fixed EXPORT_* code before any process spawns
A row in scripts/tests/local-runner-snapshot.test.mjs covers the bare, relative and in-repo git cases
